title: Excel Viewer Pro
description: View and edit Excel (.xlsx, .xls) files directly in VS Code with a beautiful spreadsheet-like interface. Supports multiple sheets, cell editing, search, and export.

title: TODO Lens — Better Comments & TODO Tree
description: Highlight TODO, FIXME, ! alerts, ? questions and more in your comments, and see every TODO in your workspace in one tree. A maintained successor to Better Comments, TODO Highlight and TODO Tree.

title: JustOpenIt!
description: Adds “Open Folder Here” and “Open Parent Folder Here” to the Explorer context menu. Because cd is apparently too much work.

title: Iron Orange
description: Metallic orange theme: copper and mandarin surfaces, orange bars and high-contrast text, even on selections. Dark and Light variants.

title: Taskit — AI Code Review Tasks
description: Finds errors, feature ideas and security issues in your workspace with Google Gemini, OpenAI or Anthropic Claude, and turns each one into a task the AI can carry out for you.

title: Kimi Extension
description: Kimi language diagnostics, build, run, and check commands for Visual Studio Code.

title: Snapline — Code Screenshots
description: Turn code into beautiful, shareable images in one click — using your exact editor theme. A maintained alternative to CodeSnap and Polacode.

title: Squadron
description: Run Claude Code, Codex and Grok sessions from a panel in your editor, and let them hand work to each other. macOS only for now.

title: juxt Theme
description: Quiet grayscale themes for VS Code in the juxt.ui design language. Green marks state.

title: Orbit STM32 Debugger
description: Modern STM32 and ARM Cortex-M debugging frontend for J-Link and CMSIS-DAP with AI integration
